title: Two speakers – English / Hindi (Male Doctor English, Female Patient Hindi)

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please come inside and have a seat. What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: नमस्ते डॉक्टर साहब। मुझे पिछले चार-पांच दिनों से बहुत तेज़ खांसी और सीने में जकड़न महसूस हो रही है।
turns.english: Hello doctor. I have had a severe cough and chest tightness for the last four to five days.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Do you have any fever or chills, especially during the evening hours?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: हाँ डॉक्टर, दो दिन पहले रात में हल्का बुखार था, लगभग सौ डिग्री, और पूरे बदन में दर्द भी था।
turns.english: Yes doctor, two days ago at night I had a mild fever, around one hundred degrees, and body ache too.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Are you coughing up any phlegm, or is it mostly a dry cough?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: शुरुआत में सूखी खांसी थी, लेकिन अब पीला कफ निकल रहा है और सांस लेने में भी थोड़ी तकलीफ होती है।
turns.english: In the beginning it was a dry cough, but now there is yellow phlegm and some difficulty in breathing.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alright. Please sit upright and take a few deep breaths while I listen to your chest with the stethoscope.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: There is some mild wheezing in the lower lobes of your lungs. Have you taken any medications yet?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: मैंने घर पर सिर्फ़ अदरक की चाय पी थी और कल रात एक पैरासिटामोल की गोली ली थी।
turns.english: At home I only had ginger tea and took one paracetamol tablet last night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. It looks like an acute bronchial infection. I am prescribing an antibiotic along with a cough syrup for five days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: क्या मुझे कोई खून की जांच या छाती का एक्स-रे भी करवाना पड़ेगा?
turns.english: Will I also need a blood test or a chest X-ray done?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let us get a chest X-ray done today just to rule out pneumonia, and then start the course of medication immediately.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: ठीक है डॉक्टर साहब, एक्स-रे की रिपोर्ट कब तक मिल जाएगी?
turns.english: Okay doctor, by when will the X-ray report be ready?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The X-ray will be ready in thirty minutes. Avoid cold drinks, take steam twice a day, and rest properly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद डॉक्टर साहब, मैं अभी एक्स-रे करवा कर आती हूँ।
turns.english: Thank you very much doctor, I will get the X-ray done right now and return.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You are welcome. Please show me the film as soon as it is done.
